⚠⚠ NEAR-DUPLICATE PAIR — MY VERDICT, WITH THE EVIDENCE. This document and 6ee0a784 ('2020_Gifford05.18.20Redacted.pdf') are THE SAME REPORT, published TWICE BY THE COUNTY AT TWO DIFFERENT REDACTION LEVELS on two different channels. I transcribed both INDEPENDENTLY, page by page, before comparing, and I never differenced a figure between them; the comparison below is offered as the evidence the brief asks for, not as a source of any value.
  * IDENTICAL: page-face candidate, office, residence city, phone, email; the filled report-type radio; the amendment answer; the signature Date and Date of Report (5/18/2020); the clerk received-stamp to the minute (20 MAY 18 PM 3:48); the foliation; and every row on both schedules — same 2 donors with the same dates and amounts in the same printed bands, same 5 vendors with the same dates, purposes and amounts in the same bands, same two footers per schedule, and the same six summary boxes (0 / 701.96 / 701.96 / 1847.78 / 1847.78 / 701.96 / -1145.82). rowbands.py returns the SAME rule positions to two decimals and the SAME per-page skews (-0.3 / -0.3 / -0.2 / -0.3) on both PDFs, which means the two files carry the same underlying scan, not two separate scans of two separate sheets.
  * THE ONE SUBSTANTIVE DIFFERENCE: on p2, THIS copy has the two donor STREET addresses BLACKED OUT by the county, while 6ee0a784 publishes them in the clear (its city/state are limited only by the form field's own truncation). This copy is the doubly-redacted one, and its filename says so ('_Redacted_Redacted'); it is the county_api (Strapi) copy, 1,188,322 bytes, sha256 1c40072c…, filed under reporting_period 'Withdraw/Elimination'. 6ee0a784 is the county_2020_page (Wayback-recovered WebLink) copy, 822,666 bytes, sha256 17ba0aba…, filed under the label 'Doug Gifford - 5/18/2020'. Different bytes, so index.csv's sha256 dedup correctly kept both; the county simply published the same report twice, redacting it further the second time.
  * CONSEQUENCE FOR THE COORDINATOR: these two records carry the SAME 7 rows and the same 701.96 / 1,847.78 sums. They are ONE report and must not be added together in any candidate-cycle total. This is the same class as the documented Canto duplicate (I4) but a step further — there the county posted ONE FILE under two report-period labels, here it posted TWO FILES of one report with different redaction. Recorded, not adjudicated; nothing was merged and neither copy was treated as a correction of the other.
  * IT ALSO CONFIRMS ADDENDUM I4 DIRECTLY: 'a filename is not evidence of redaction' — here the SAME PAGE is redacted in the file whose name says Redacted twice and unredacted in the file whose name says it once.
